addExtrude.description: A flat outline [[x,y],...] in the x,y plane, pushed out depth along z and centred on it: wings, fins, plates, brackets. Ordinary extrusions support disjoint through-hole rings strictly inside the outline, with flat edges only. Optional taper or shift makes a sharp closed transition: the negative-z end is the outline, the positive-z end is outline*taper+shift, scaling about the local origin. Defaults in this mode: taper 1, shift [0,0]. taper 0.05..20; both end coordinates -100..100; depth 0.01..100. Requires a simple polygon, 3..40 points, either winding. Invalid or Float32-unsafe geometry rejects, not repairs. Bevel must be omitted/null/0; through-holes are not supported in this mode.

addLathe.description: A profile [[radius,y],...] spun round the y axis: bodies, nozzles, rings, bottles. sides makes it faceted (default quality tiers: 20/36/64). Optional sweep 1..359 degrees makes a closed sector from +z towards +x about +y; rotate to choose its start. Sector profile: simple closed polygon, 3..40 points (one repeated closing point allowed), radius 0..100, y -100..100. Invalid, touching, intersecting or Float32-unsafe profiles and invalid sweeps are rejected, not repaired. Either winding; exact redundant collinear boundary points are removed. sides is segments per full revolution (sector segments scale proportionally, at most 90 degrees each).

addConnector.description: A physical rope, belt, wire, chain or pipe between two parts of one 3D model, its ends on them, following them as they move (it never links panels, cards or marks: flat diagram arrows are edge). kind straight (default) is taut and shortens as a weight rises; slack hangs in a sag; wrapped is a flat belt round two wheels. fromSide and toSide say where an end meets its object, as seen from the front (left, right, top, bottom, front, back; the rim of a wheel), else its middle; fromAnchor and toAnchor name a point of a ready-made part.

along.description: id of an existing tube, line, arrow, connector or flow-diagram edge that they travel along

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

toColor.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

by.description: a spinning part to run in step with

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

surge.description: flow in beats: the markers speed up and slow down once a beat by this fraction of their speed (0.8 is strong surges, as blood in a pulse); not with by; 0.05 to 0.95

addStream.description: Dots, dashes or arrows travelling along a tube, line, arrow, connector or an edge of a flow diagram, running on by themselves. period is the seconds a marker takes for the whole way (negative runs backwards, default 4); or by a spinning part, ratio laps for each turn. color changes to toColor along the way (shiftAt, 0 to 1, is where).

parent.description: id of a group, part or shape to attach to; create a new parent no later than this child (it carries this along)

shift.description: where the middle of the box they fill is, from the middle of the box they start in; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

draw.description: how spread out they are at first, 0 crowded in the start box to 1 filling the other (default 0); grow it with reveal; 0 to 1

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addParticles.description: A cloud of count small particles (default 30) that spread out: they begin in a box of size from at pos and, as reveal takes the cloud from 0 to 1 (it begins at 0, so they start crowded), drift apart to fill a box of size to, centred shift further on, all the while jostling. Diffusion, a gas filling a room, a drop of dye in water. A membrane is a plane or box between.

on.description: the part the force acts on

dir.description: the direction it points, [x,y,z] in the scene: [0,-1,0] is down; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addForce.description: An arrow for a force on a part: from a point of it (point, default center) the way dir points in the scene (not the part: gravity stays down as the part turns), strength units long and thicker the stronger, following the part wherever it goes. Colour it, name it with a pin; scale it up or down to change its strength, loop pulse it to make it come and go. It goes when the part does.

parent.description: id of a group, part or shape to attach to; create a new parent no later than this child (it carries this along)

flip.description: reverse the way the lines point

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addField.description: Field lines as arrows, drawn for you in the front plane round pos: dipole (a bar magnet or a pair of charges: lines leave the end on the positive axis side and curve round to the other), radial (spokes out from a point charge or in to a mass: flip reverses them), uniform (parallel lines along axis, between plates or near the ground). size is how far they reach (default 5), count how many (default 8), gap the room between poles or plates (dipole, uniform). One group: clear its id to take them all away.

parent.description: id of a group, part or shape to attach to; create a new parent no later than this child (it carries this along)

parentAnchor.description: attach at this named point of the parent (requires parent): a built-in name, a kit part's own, or one named with the anchor action; origin when only selfAnchor is set. The part then stays at that point whatever moves, spins or is dragged, and pos and move are its offset from the point; up to 24 characters

selfAnchor.description: the point of this object placed at parentAnchor, default origin; requires parent. Unknown names drop the action with the available ones; up to 24 characters

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addPart.description: A ready-made part fitted to the box size [x,y,z]. Electronics: chip (variant black or metal), header (n pins per row, two rows), port (variant usb, usb3, ethernet, hdmi, usbc; its opening faces +z), lens, screen, button, fan (n blades, axis y), wheel (n spokes, axis z). Mechanism, axis y: cylinder-block (variant cutaway or finned; the bore is round in x,z), piston, connecting-rod (small end up), valve (head down), spark-plug (tip down), spring (n coils), pipe, elbow, housing (variant cutaway); axis z: crankshaft (n throws), camshaft (n lobes), gear (n teeth), bearing (n balls). Each has good proportions; mechanism anchors and the origin of every part can be used by pins, connectors and parentAnchor/selfAnchor placement.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addArray.description: Copies of an existing object, count in all (the original is the first). step moves each copy [x,y,z] from the last; turn rotates each copy about the origin of the group the original sits in, which is how to put blades round a hub.

parent.description: id of a group, part or shape to attach to; create a new parent no later than this child (it carries this along)

parentAnchor.description: attach at this named point of the parent (requires parent): a built-in name, a kit part's own, or one named with the anchor action; origin when only selfAnchor is set. The part then stays at that point whatever moves, spins or is dragged, and pos and move are its offset from the point; up to 24 characters

selfAnchor.description: the point of this object placed at parentAnchor, default origin; requires parent. Unknown names drop the action with the available ones; up to 24 characters

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addText.description: Text in the 3D scene that always faces the camera; height is in 3D units.

parent.description: id of a group, part or shape to attach to; create a new parent no later than this child (it carries this along)

parentAnchor.description: attach at this named point of the parent (requires parent): a built-in name, a kit part's own, or one named with the anchor action; origin when only selfAnchor is set. The part then stays at that point whatever moves, spins or is dragged, and pos and move are its offset from the point; up to 24 characters

selfAnchor.description: the point of this object placed at parentAnchor, default origin; requires parent. Unknown names drop the action with the available ones; up to 24 characters

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addGroup.description: An empty node to move, turn and scale other objects together (attach them with parent).

anchor.description: a named point of a ready-made part, instead of point; up to 24 characters

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

pin.description: A label pinned to a 3D object: a dot at point (in the object's own space, default its middle), a line and a tag that follow it as it moves. off is where the tag sits from the dot in screen units (default [0,-90]).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

move.description: Move a 3D object to an absolute position.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

along.description: Move a 3D object along a smooth path through the points, ending on the last.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

turn.description: Turn a 3D object to absolute angles in degrees; from [0,0,0], [0,360,0] is one full spin.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

scale.description: Scale a 3D object to absolute factors [x,y,z] (1 is the size it was added at).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

explode.description: Spread the parts of a group outward from its origin: 0 assembled, 1 apart (up to 3). A part that has its own explode offset moves by that offset times the spread instead. Back to 0 to assemble.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

reveal.description: Draw a tube, line or arrow on, from its start: to 1 is all of it.

anchor.description: Name a point on a 3D object, in its own space, for parentAnchor or selfAnchor: write it right after the object.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

detach.description: Let an attached part go: it stays where it is and is placed on its own from then (no join line). To lift a part out and still show where it goes, move it instead.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

style.description: Change the colour and/or opacity of any object or mark; at least one of them.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

highlight.description: Pulse an object or mark to draw the eye, optionally in a colour.

onlyAxis.description: with rpm 0: stop only a spin about axis, and leave any other as it is

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

spin.description: Make a part turn round its own axis and keep turning, until another spin on it says otherwise. rpm is turns a minute (negative the other way; 0 stops; dur is the time to get up to speed). Or give by, another part that drives it: it then turns ratio times as far as that part (0.5 half as fast, -1 a meshed gear) and phase degrees ahead. axis is x, y or z, default z (use y for a fan).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

crank.description: Tie a piston to a spinning crankshaft through a connecting rod: the piston slides up and down its cylinder (along y, in the x,y plane) as the crank pin goes round, and the rod swings to join them. piston, shaft and rod are the ids of the piston (never the cylinder block), the crankshaft and the connecting rod. Put the three in one group, the crankshaft turning with spin. On a plain cylinder laid on its side as the crankshaft, the crank draws the pin and runs the rod on it in front of the disc: add no pin of your own. pin is which throw (1 is the first).

lift.description: how far it moves down in units (default a fifth of its length); 0.01 to 50

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

cam.description: A valve (or any follower) that a spinning camshaft pushes down along y: it is down by lift while the cam nose points down at it, and back up otherwise. open is how many degrees of the turn of the cam it stays open (default 110), phase the cam angle where it is most open (default 180: the nose pointing down). valve is the id of the valve, by of the camshaft.

by.description: the part whose turning times it

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

flash.description: A glow that comes on at one point of the cycle of a turning part: the object (a small sphere for a spark, a larger one for the burn) is invisible, flares to its opacity at the crank angle given and dies away over span degrees. by is the crankshaft; angle is degrees into a cycle of cycle degrees (default 720, a four-stroke engine: 0 is the piston at the top starting the intake, 360 the top of the compression).

amount.description: slide: positive total travel in units; swing: signed degrees each side (negative reverses the swing, zero holds still); pulse: positive size factor (1.3 is 30% bigger, 0.8 smaller); gate: degrees the hinge opens on half of each cycle; float: units it bobs up and down; -360 to 360

damp.description: cycles for the motion to fall to a third of its size, so it settles (a pendulum running down); left out, it never settles; 0.2 to 50

tilt.description: float: degrees it rocks from side to side about z (default 4); 0 to 30

ratio.description: with by: cycles per turn (default 1); -20 to 20

phase.description: degrees ahead (180 is half a cycle behind another loop at 0); -3600 to 3600

pivot.description: swing: from the object to the point it turns about; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

loop.description: Repeat a motion on any object: slide (back and forth along axis, positive amount units in all), swing (rock about axis by signed amount degrees each side, -180 to 180, about the hinge pivot; negative reverses it, zero holds still) or pulse (swell to positive amount times its size), every period seconds (default 2) or by a spinning part. Left out, kind is the joint's. Another loop replaces it; stop ends it. id is an object already in the scene, never a name for the loop.

pivot.description: hinge or ball: from the object to the point it turns about; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

about.description: hinge or ball: a point of the object by name (built in, a kit part own or one named with anchor) to turn about, instead of pivot; up to 24 characters

limit.description: ball: how far each axis may turn each way, degrees [x,y,z]; [x,y,z], each 0 to 360

to.description: fixed: the object it rides with

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

joint.description: Give any object a freedom: hinge (turns about axis through pivot, the point from the object), slide (along axis or a tilted dir: an inclined plane, a wedge), pivot (turns about its own long axis, axis y by default, through its own middle: a forearm, a screw, a tap), ball (turns about all three axes about its pivot point, held to limit [x,y,z] degrees each way: a shoulder, a hip; one swing loop or spin per axis drives it), fixed (rides with to). about names the point to turn about (any point of the part: left, top, a named one) instead of pivot. min and max hold its value. It moves when spin, loop or couple drives it.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

couple.description: One joint follows another: its value is ratio times that of by, plus phase. Use ratio between two of a kind (gear, belt, lever) and pitch between a hinge and a slide (units of travel for one turn: a screw, a rack, a rope on a wheel is 2 x pi x radius). stop ends it.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

lever.description: A beam that rocks about a fulcrum: a hinge at fulcrum, a point of the beam (center, the default, is a seesaw and the first class; left or right, an end, with the load or the effort between it and the other end, is the second and third class; or a point named with anchor), swinging swing degrees each side every period seconds. Attach the load and the effort at points of the beam (parentAnchor) and they rise and fall with it.

pulls.description: the id of the part it pulls (an end of the connector), or from or to for that end; up to 40 characters

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

muscle.description: A connector that is a muscle: it shortens by contract (a fraction of its relaxed length, 0.02 to 0.9, default 0.2) and lengthens again every period seconds (default 2), and the part it pulls (pulls, the id of one of its two ends, or from or to, with a hinge or pivot joint with min and max to hold it) is turned by it, not beside it. Join the ends with fromPoint and toPoint or fromAnchor and toAnchor; its belly swells as it shortens (swell). id is the connector.

axis.description: the axis the wheel turns about: left out, a cylinder turns about its own long axis as it lies and anything else about z

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

pulley.description: A rope over a wheel: the wheel (wheel) turns rpm turns a minute (default 20, negative the other way) and the load (id) rises by the rope laid on it, 2 x pi x radius for each turn. radius is the rope's radius on the wheel, read from the wheel's size when left out. A winch, a crane drum and a wheel and axle (give the axle's radius) are the same.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

wave.description: A wave running along a tube: peristalsis, a pulse down a vessel. amount is the radius at its crest as a factor (above 1 a swell, below 1 a squeeze; default 1.6), width the fraction of the tube it spans (default 0.2), count how many run at once, period the seconds a crest takes for the whole tube (default 4, negative runs backwards). A one-marker stream along the same tube with the same period rides the crest (a mouthful going down). stop true ends it.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

pendulum.description: A weight hanging from a point and swinging: id is the weight, from the part it hangs from (the swing is about its middle) or pivot, the point from the weight to the hang point. swing is degrees each side (default 25), period seconds (left out, longer for a longer string), damp cycles for it to settle. It starts let go at the far end. Draw the string as a connector between the two.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

oscillate.description: A weight bobbing on a spring or elastic: it moves amount units each way along axis (default y) every period seconds (default 1.5), starting pulled to the low end and let go, and settles if damp (cycles to fall to a third) is given. Draw the spring or elastic as a connector from its fixed end to the weight.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

float.description: Buoyancy, illustrated: the part rides on water, bobbing bob units up and down (default 0.15) and rocking tilt degrees (default 4) every period seconds (default 3). Put it at the water line first (drop does that); damp settles it.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

drop.description: Gravity, illustrated: the part falls to height to (y, in the units of the group it is in) with an ever faster pull, and bounces bounce (0 lands dead, 0.8 very springy, default 0.3) times lower each time until it settles. dur left out, it takes as long as the fall.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

pump.description: A chamber that squeezes and refills behind one-way valves: id is the chamber (it shrinks to squeeze of its size, default 0.7, then refills, every period seconds, default 1.2), inlet the flap that opens while it refills and outlet the flap that opens while it squeezes. Each valve turns about its hinge point (a named point of the valve, default left) by open degrees (default 70, negative the other way).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

incline.description: An inclined plane: the load (id) slides up and down the slope, travel units in all (default 4) every period seconds (default 4). The slope is the turn of the ramp (a box turned about z; its length runs along x), or angle degrees.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

wedge.description: A wedge driven in along axis (default y), travel units in all (default 2) every period seconds (default 3), pushing the part it drives (drives) aside across axis by tan(angle) of its own travel, angle being the half angle of the wedge in degrees (default 20): an axe in a log, a door stop. Put the driven part to the side of the wedge it is to be pushed to. Write it again for the other side.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

screw.description: A screw and its nut: the screw (screw) turns rpm turns a minute (default 30) and the nut (id) travels along its length pitch units for each turn (default 0.5, negative the other way). A cylinder turns about its own long axis as it lies; axis says otherwise.

normal.description: nonzero local cut direction; do not combine with axis; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

cut.description: Cut a 3D object and its children open. Choose axis x/y/z or normal [x,y,z], never both. normal is a nonzero local direction with finite components from -100 to 100; magnitude is ignored. to is signed distance along that unit direction from the local origin (not necessarily the center of a hull point cloud); the positive side is removed. Omit direction to keep the active cut direction (initially +z). Direction changes at the action start; only to animates. Closed opaque pieces are capped; open surfaces are not. to 100 removes the cut.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

orbit.description: Move the camera around what it looks at: az is the angle around (0 faces the front), el the height angle.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

zoom.description: Camera distance factor: 1 is the default framing, 2 is twice as close.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

focus.description: Aim the camera at a 3D object; without id, back at the middle of the stage.

wait.description: Guide mode: once this step has been drawn and spoken, wait for the person to click, and go on to the next step only when the screen has really changed. x,y,w,h is the box (top-left corner and size, on the screenshot) the click should land in; leave it out when it could be anywhere. Draw the target with a mark as well, and give each guide step its own ids.

go.description: Guide mode, optional: let the app make one navigation move for the person, in a step that points at it (the wait stays: if the app does not do it, they click). kind is tab (a tab), open (a menu item that opens a submenu) or scroll (a window or area; dir down by default). x,y is the middle of that control on the screenshot (anywhere in the area for scroll). The app does it only in a native window, only if the person has allowed it, says so aloud first, and refuses everything that is not exactly this (a button, a link, a checkbox, a field, anything that saves, sends, deletes or buys). At most one a step.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

clear.description: Remove an object or mark (and what is attached to it), or everything with "all", every mark, card, diagram and pin with "marks", the 3D stage and its objects with "panel".

step.description: What is said and what appears while it is said. At most 24 actions.

say.description: The words spoken for this step, up to 400 characters
